description: React component for vault dialog handling in Notesnook app, including vault management, password handling, biometric authentication, and note operations.

classes.name: VaultDialog
classes.description: React functional component managing vault interactions, including password, biometric auth, note operations, and dialog UI.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and displays the vault dialog with provided data, checks biometric availability, and may trigger biometric auth.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the vault dialog and resets state.

methods.name: deleteVault
methods.description: Deletes vault data, optionally all notes, after password verification.

methods.name: clearVault
methods.description: Clears vault contents after password verification.

methods.name: lockNote
methods.description: Locks a note in the vault with a password.

methods.name: permanantUnlock
methods.description: Removes note from vault, unlocking it permanently.

methods.name: openInEditor
methods.description: Opens a note in the editor after vault unlock.

methods.name: shareNote
methods.description: Shares note content via native share dialog.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from vault and database.

methods.name: openNote
methods.description: Unlocks and opens a note, with options for editing, sharing, or deleting.

methods.name: unlockNote
methods.description: Unlocks a note, either permanently or for editing.

methods.name: enrollFingerprint
methods.description: Enables biometric fingerprint authentication for vault access.

methods.name: createVault
methods.description: Creates a new vault with password and optional biometric setup.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Main handler for dialog button actions, managing vault creation, unlocking, password change, and note operations.
